title: Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch Wall-Mounted W/ Gallery Rail, Solid Brass | Polished Nickel | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Organize toiletries where you need them—this wall-mounted double glass shelf keeps bottles and daily bathroom essentials off the counter while staying easy to reach in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. This glass shelf works as a bathroom shelf and wall shelf, with a gallery rail designed to keep your items in place.

Highlights:
- Polished Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Pairs seamlessly with matching Waverly Place hardware for refined continuity
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Strong, coordinating hardware—solid brass construction with concealed screw mounting for a clean look
- Designed to match—part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place pieces and transitional bath accessories / transitional bathroom hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: wall-mounted glass shelf (bathroom shelf / wall shelf)
- Shelf glass dimensions: 22 x 5 Inches
- Overall dimensions: 22 in L x 5 in projection x 8 in H
- Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8-Inch), tempered
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging; concealed screw mounting
- Assembly required: false
- Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4"
